# grouper_groups (Data Source)

Lists the groups in a Grouper folder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grouper_groups" "apps" {
  folder    = "org:dept:apps"
  recursive = true
}

# Grants a group read on every group in the folder and its subfolders
resource "grouper_group_privileges" "auditors" {
  for_each = { for g in data.grouper_groups.apps.groups : g.name => g.id }

  group         = each.value
  subject_group = grouper_group.auditors.id
  privileges    = ["read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder` (String) Current full name of the folder, such as `org:dept:apps`.

### Optional

- `recursive` (Boolean) Also lists the groups in the folder's subfolders, at any depth. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) The groups, sorted by full name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `composite` (Attributes) Set when the group's members are the combination of two other groups' members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups--composite))
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `display_extension` (String) Display name of the group itself, shown in the Grouper UI.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the group and its folders, separated by colons.
- `id` (String) UUID of the group.
- `name` (String) Full name of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--groups--composite"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups.composite`

Read-Only:

- `left_group` (String) UUID of the first group.
- `right_group` (String) UUID of the second group.
- `type` (String) `union`, `intersection`, or `complement`, which is members of `left_group` who aren't in `right_group`.
